name: Re:Collector- ~Gyaku Rape ni wa Kusshinai Monogatari~
original_name: Re:コレクター ～逆レイプには屈しない物語～
source:
I woke up in a mysterious forest.
I had no idea who I was or why I was here.
Then, I met some friends and went on an adventure...

[From [url=https://medibang.itch.io/re-collector]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我在一片神秘的森林中醒来。
不知道自己是谁，也不知道为何身在此处。
后来，我遇见了几位朋友，踏上了一场冒险……

[摘自[url=https://medibang.itch.io/re-collector]Itch.io[/url]]
